1.title: U.S. Strikes Iran Again, as Trump Encounters a More Determined Adversary in Widened War
1.summary: The United States is again exchanging strikes with Iran, just days after the president appeared to reject plans to escalate.

2.title: Anthony Fauci refuses to answer questions during tense US Senate hearing about Covid origins
2.summary: The former top US health official said he feared Republicans could try to trip him up and use his testimony to prosecute him for perjury.

3.title: Dentists in Brooklyn Exploited Patients in Pain, Lawsuit Charges
3.summary: New York City sued two dental practices, saying they offered patients high-interest loans to pay their bills and often falsely said procedures were not covered by insurance.

4.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. Begins New Wave of Attacks on Iran, Military Says
4.summary: U.S. Central Command announced the strikes hours after President Trump vowed to hit Iran “very hard” in response to an attempted Iranian attack on U.S. forces in Jordan.

5.title: Trump considering AI controls after OpenAI hacking incidents
5.summary: It marks a change of tone for his administration, which has taken a more hands-off approach to the technology.

6.title: BTS Won’t Enter Music From Comeback Album for Grammy Awards
6.summary: The group announced it would not submit its most recent album, ‘Arirang,’ for consideration a month after the Recording Academy introduced a new category for Asian pop.
